source_meta._title: '/locate', explorer maps, and treasure maps can cause extreme TPS lag, even leading to a complete server freeze if structure generation is turned off

stor.environment: Unmodified Minecraft Java Edition 1.14.4 in singleplayer, using the integrated server and a newly created world with Generate Structures set to OFF and commands enabled. This version and setup are selected because the report provides a direct singleplayer reproduction for 1.14.4.
preconditions: Install and launch the unmodified Java Edition 1.14.4 client; do not use OptiFine, mods, plugins, or a third-party server.
Use a disposable new world. No particular world seed is specified by the report.

The computer must remain available long enough for the observation subsystem to monitor the game after the command is submitted; the duration and severity of the response may depend on system performance.
Do not use an existing world whose chunks or structures were generated under different settings.
Trigger the test only once. Repeated /locate commands are unnecessary and may create additional lag or cause a watchdog termination.

steps.action: In the Minecraft Launcher, select the installation that runs Java Edition 1.14.4, then start the game.
steps.success_cue: The Minecraft main menu is visible and identifies the running version as Minecraft 1.14.4.

steps.action: Select the Singleplayer button from the main menu.
steps.success_cue: The Select World screen is open.
The Create New World configuration screen is visible.

steps.action: Optionally give the disposable test world a recognizable name. Leave the world seed unspecified and leave the game mode and world type at their defaults; the report does not require particular values for them.
steps.success_cue: The new-world configuration screen remains open and the test world can be identified by its name.

steps.action: Select More World Options... to expose the structure-generation and command-permission settings.
steps.success_cue: The additional world options are visible, including Generate Structures and Allow Cheats.

steps.action: Select the Generate Structures button until its displayed state is OFF. Do not turn it back on before creating the world.
steps.success_cue: The option visibly reads Generate Structures: OFF.

steps.action: Select the Allow Cheats button until its displayed state is ON. This is needed so the supplied /locate command can be executed from in-game chat.
steps.success_cue: The option visibly reads Allow Cheats: ON while Generate Structures still reads OFF.

steps.action: Select Create New World to generate and enter the world using the displayed settings.
steps.success_cue: The loading screen completes and the player appears in the newly created world.

steps.action: Do not run the command during initial world loading. Wait until nearby terrain has rendered, the loading overlay is gone, the HUD is visible, and ordinary movement responds normally.
steps.success_cue: The player can look and move normally in the loaded world before the test command is entered.

steps.action: Press the Open Chat control, which is T by default, to open the in-game chat entry field.
steps.success_cue: A chat input field with a text cursor is visible at the bottom of the screen.

steps.action: Type the report's command exactly into in-game chat. Include the leading slash and preserve the structure argument shown in the report. Do not submit it yet.
steps.success_cue: The chat input field contains exactly /locate Village.

steps.action: Press Enter once to submit the command. Do not issue another command, pause the game, open a menu, or attempt to close the world after submission; immediately hand control to the observation subsystem.
steps.success_cue: The /locate Village command has just been submitted and no additional test action has been initiated.

stor.handoff_condition: The player is in a newly created Minecraft Java Edition 1.14.4 singleplayer world made with Generate Structures set to OFF, and /locate Village has just been submitted once through in-game chat. Begin observing integrated-server responsiveness immediately without performing further player actions.
uncertainties: The report does not provide a required world seed, spawn location, game mode, difficulty, render distance, or hardware specification.
The time between command submission and any performance effect is hardware-dependent; no fixed wait duration is supported by the report.

The issue includes other trigger paths involving explorer maps and treasure-map chests, but this plan intentionally uses the simpler deterministic /locate Village path explicitly documented for a structure-disabled 1.14.4 singleplayer world.
Although the issue lists many affected versions, Minecraft Java Edition 1.14.4 is recommended because the report contains a complete, explicit reproduction sequence for that version.

The report describes TPS lag and possible complete freezing; the setup does not require a dedicated server because its 1.14.4 reproduction explicitly uses singleplayer, whose world runs on an integrated server.
